# sailpoint_source_aggregation_schedule (Resource)

Manages a SailPoint source aggregation schedule. Aggregation schedules determine when a source performs account and entitlement aggregations. Each source supports up to two schedule types: `ACCOUNTS` and `ENTITLEMENTS`.

The resource ID is a composite of `<source_id>/<schedule_type>`. To import: `terraform import sailpoint_source_aggregation_schedule.example <source_id>/<schedule_type>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Schedule account aggregation for an existing source to run on weekday mornings.
# Requires the parent sailpoint_source to exist first.
resource "sailpoint_source_aggregation_schedule" "accounts_nightly" {
  source_id     = "REPLACE_WITH_SOURCE_ID"
  schedule_type = "ACCOUNTS"

  schedule = {
    type = "WEEKLY"

    hours = {
      type   = "LIST"
      values = ["2"] # 02:00 UTC
    }

    days = {
      type   = "LIST"
      values = ["MON", "TUE", "WED", "THU", "FRI"]
    }

    time_zone_id = "UTC"
  }

  enable_threshold = false
}

# Entitlement aggregation on Sunday nights with thresholding enabled.
# If more than 20% of entitlements change in a single run, the aggregation
# is paused and requires manual review in the SailPoint UI.
resource "sailpoint_source_aggregation_schedule" "entitlements_weekly" {
  source_id     = "REPLACE_WITH_SOURCE_ID"
  schedule_type = "ENTITLEMENTS"

  schedule = {
    type = "WEEKLY"

    hours = {
      type   = "LIST"
      values = ["1"] # 01:00 UTC
    }

    days = {
      type   = "LIST"
      values = ["SUN"]
    }

    time_zone_id = "UTC"
  }

  enable_threshold = true
  threshold        = 20
}

# Daily account aggregation — no days component needed for DAILY type.
resource "sailpoint_source_aggregation_schedule" "accounts_daily" {
  source_id     = "REPLACE_WITH_SOURCE_ID"
  schedule_type = "ACCOUNTS"

  schedule = {
    type = "DAILY"

    hours = {
      type   = "LIST"
      values = ["4"] # 04:00 UTC
    }

    time_zone_id = "America/Chicago"
  }

  enable_threshold = false
}

# Import an existing schedule that was configured outside Terraform:
#   terraform import sailpoint_source_aggregation_schedule.accounts_nightly REPLACE_WITH_SOURCE_ID/ACCOUNTS
```

## Schema

### Required

- `schedule` (Attributes) The timing configuration for this aggregation schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `schedule_type` (String) The type of aggregation schedule. Valid values: `ACCOUNTS`, `ENTITLEMENTS`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `source_id` (String) The ID of the source this schedule belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `credentials_in_body` (Boolean) Whether to include credentials in the aggregation request body. Computed from the source configuration.
- `enable_threshold` (Boolean) When `true`, enables delta aggregation thresholding. If the number of accounts or entitlements changed exceeds the `threshold` percentage, the aggregation is paused for review.
- `threshold` (Number) The percentage threshold for delta aggregation. Only meaningful when `enable_threshold` is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite resource ID (`<source_id>/<schedule_type>`). Computed by the provider.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `hours` (Attributes) The hours component of the schedule — specifies the hour(s) of day when the aggregation runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule--hours))
- `type` (String) The schedule recurrence type. Valid values: `DAILY`, `WEEKLY`, `MONTHLY`, `CALENDAR`.

Optional:

- `days` (Attributes) The days component of the schedule — specifies the day(s) of week or month when the aggregation runs. Required for `WEEKLY` and `MONTHLY` schedules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule--days))
- `months` (Attributes) The months component of the schedule — specifies the month(s) when the aggregation runs. Required for `CALENDAR` schedules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule--months))
- `time_zone_id` (String) The IANA time zone identifier for the schedule (e.g. `UTC`, `America/Chicago`). Defaults to `UTC` when not specified.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule--hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule.hours`

Required:

- `type` (String) The type of schedule unit. Valid values: `DAILY`, `WEEKLY`, `MONTHLY`, `CALENDAR`, `LIST`, `RANGE`.

Optional:

- `interval` (Number) The interval for RANGE-type schedules (e.g. every N days).
- `values` (List of String) The list of values for the schedule unit (e.g. `["MON", "WED", "FRI"]` for days, `["3"]` for hour 3 AM).
